topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by outlining its learning outcomes, review background, and overarching thematic structure.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Intracellular Proliferative Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in growth factor receptors and downstream signaling cascades drive sustained cellular proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Leukemias and Carcinomas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations arrest normal lineage differentiation in both hematopoietic and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how p53 disruption and the balance of mitochondrial Bcl-2 family proteins allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how cancer cells overcome telomere-mediated division limits by reactivating telomerase and bypassing p53-dependent senescence.

topics.label: Reprogrammed Cancer Metabolism and the Warburg Effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the metabolic shift of cancer cells toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic mutations generate oncometabolites that alter gene regulation.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how developing tumors overcome hypoxia by tipping the regulatory balance of signaling factors to stimulate new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, Dissemination, and Diagnostics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses the multistep metastatic cascade, circulatory dissemination, diagnostic tracking via liquid biopsies, and clonal genomic features of metastases.

topics.label: Conclusion and Practical Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides closing lecture framing by summarizing the cancer hallmarks framework and pointing students to upcoming practical sessions.
